q: How many players from one team are on the field at a time in association football (soccer)?
e: Each side fields 11 players, including the goalkeeper.

q: In which sport is a score of zero called "love"?
e: Tennis uses 'love' for zero, as in 'fifteen-love'.

q: How many interlocking rings appear on the Olympic flag?
e: The five rings represent the union of the five inhabited continents as conceived in the Olympic movement.

q: Which country won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930?
e: Hosts Uruguay beat Argentina 4–2 in the 1930 final in Montevideo.

q: How many legal deliveries make up a standard over in cricket?
e: A standard over consists of six legal deliveries.

q: In which city were the first modern Olympic Games held in 1896?
e: The 1896 Games in Athens were the first of the modern Olympic era.

q: Who was the first batter to score a double century in a men's One Day International?
e: Tendulkar scored 200* against South Africa in Gwalior in February 2010. Belinda Clark had made the first women's ODI 200 in 1997.

q: What is the official distance of a marathon?
e: The marathon distance was standardised at 42.195 km (26 miles 385 yards) in 1921.
